name: mcmc-painter-web
description: Real-time MCMC artistic painting web application

scripts.build-wasm: emcc mcmc_wasm.cpp -o mcmc_wasm.js -s WASM=1 -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME='Module' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap"]' -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_malloc","_free"]' --bind -O3 -std=c++11
scripts.debug-wasm: emcc mcmc_wasm.cpp -o mcmc_wasm.js -s WASM=1 -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME='Module' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap"]' -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_malloc","_free"]' --bind -g -s ASSERTIONS=1 -std=c++11

author: David Hodgson
